interpretation: Source checks, actual developer browser paths and visual inspection have separate scopes. Totals are not additive quality scores. No listening or newcomer comprehension result is inferred.

runs.name: surface and vessel source history
runs.scope: Separate recorded runs with their actual forward working-tree scope, including frozen geometry negative controls, failures, corrections and 326/327 earlier full-source checkpoints. Not all final-package results.

runs.scope: Frozen cd73f2a with observation-only render dataset added. At actual Lookout arrival signed feet radius is negative and camera is inside globe. Held real S movement retains the failure. Expected-broken label never converts a failed product assertion to pass.

Every observed render checks signed feet/camera/real sea boundary. Before final Watch-only targeting and sound menu changes; ordinary movement/camera formula remains unchanged.

No autoplay bypass. Same complete 69-file application as promoted release.

runs.scope: 69 compiled files exactly match reviewed candidate. All rows in twelve current tables preserved, including 44 sound rows at switch. 62 served files and cache headers verified. User world never used for write tests.

failures.correction: Reject opposite hemisphere before footprint/floor/wall tests; use actual raised-plane intersection. No camera-height patch or source-coordinate migration.

failures.correction: Restart both independent candidate services from the complete package before source/browser acceptance; final release bytes equal the reviewed complete candidate.

failures.correction: Use the actual visible core action, or its normal reopen button, with no forced click or injected product state.

isolation: Frozen baseline18910, source suite18911 and independent browser world18912 each have separate ignored databases. Browser tests accept only designated scratch port/path. User18861 receives the app-only switch and read-only blocked-write observer.
visualReview: Root inspected actual coast-before/after and boat desktop/phone plus pinwheel renders. Final ferry is recognisable and centered by Watch; pinwheel remains a deliberately small local prop. Screenshots are actual renders, never concepts.
limits: Up to three visible live public horn ferries and six breeze pinwheels, selected canonically; dense histories can exhaust the visual budget.
The existing horn recording/emitter stays fixed; a moving ferry is a visible response, not a relocated spatial audio source or a human participant.
The ferry route needs a valid sampled ocean course. Original moored sailboat remains scenery.
3D received the motion props and hemisphere floor repair. Optional 2D/2.5D lenses retain prior state but were not revalidated or extended here.
A bounded coastal route and geometry sweep do not prove all future positions, meshes or camera paths.
No new recording, asset download, schema migration or fabricated contribution was introduced.
